# Apoptosis partial fabrication variant E

Cell death regulator analysis showed altered BCL2 family dynamics. BCL2 was upregulated (Table 3). BAX was downregulated (Table 3). CASP3 was elevated (Table 3). TP53 was upregulated (Table 3). CDKN1A was upregulated (Table 3). MYC was downregulated (Table 3).
